_readme: Single source of truth for where things live. Read this first, after bootstrap.

sheet.access: Composio googlesheets toolkit. Rate limit 60 reads/min, 60 writes/min - batch writes.

_endpoints_note: URLs are written with the full https:// scheme DELIBERATELY. A URL in a project file unlocks web_fetch only if schemed. Bare hostnames cost a redundant web_search every session - which is exactly what the old data.md did.

mirror.status_20260820: FROZEN at 3 Aug. Zero changes vs baseline across all 567 rows. Now a FALLBACK only.

access_routes.composio_sandbox: Reaches the FULL FPL API including entry/, element-summary/, event/live - all four that data.md called permanently blocked. This is the PRIMARY route. Free, unlimited.
access_routes.container_bash: raw.githubusercontent.com only. api.github.com is 60 req/hr PER SHARED IP - treat as unavailable. fantasy.premierleague.com NOT reachable.
access_routes.web_fetch: Only URLs already in context. Schemed URLs in project files qualify; bare hostnames do not.
access_routes.reddit: Composio reddit toolkit. Direct fetch is SITE_BLOCKED. Search + comment retrieval both work.
access_routes.zenrows: Connected. plan.livefpl.net returns 422 even with premium_proxy - unresolved as of 20 Aug. Retry post-deadline when EO data exists. Screenshots remain the fallback.
